So more than half of people who voted on my poll last week don't have optical drives on their everyday rig. I mean, reasonable since it's 2026.

Now, since the LG TV news broke out, that got me thinking while eating frozen spaghetti & watching the Gamers Nexus vid

How many VGA monitors do you actively use on your main everyday rig ?

I have 2 that I use on this archlinux rig. I'm not gonna count the 1 for my proxmox rig since I don't interact with it everyday and I only turn on the monitor when I solve a problem on it
